visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Deep ambient shadows for floating nav: shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)]

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular, border 1px solid #C8A96A, transparent bg. On hover: bg-[#C8A96A] text-[#111111]. Add group-hover arrow slide animation.
components.cards: Cardless or 1px border. Dark surface bg. High padding (p-8 to p-12).
components.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Massive outline text (text-transparent [-webkit-text-stroke:1px_#C8A96A] opacity-50) moving slowly behind sections.
components.timeline: Vertical left-bordered line in gold. Scroll-triggered height filling. Nodes are gold dots.
components.accordion: Shadcn accordion. Minimalist, border-b only. Title in Playfair Display. Plus/minus icon rotating on active.
components.navigation: Sticky, glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60), gold active state dot.
components.lightbox: Implement a framer-motion AnimatePresence lightbox for the product gallery images.
components.scroll_progress: Framer motion scaleX fixed progress bar at top of screen in Gold.

motion.scroll_library: Use `@studio-freight/react-lenis` for smooth momentum scrolling. Required for luxury feel.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use `framer-motion` for complex scrolling reveals and `lucide-react` for minimalist icons.
Install and use `@studio-freight/react-lenis` or `lenis` for smooth scrolling. This is MANDATORY for the luxury feel.
Install and use `react-fast-marquee` for the editorial marquee band.
NEVER use generic purple or bright gradient backgrounds. Rely on #111111 (Black) and #F5F5F0 (Ivory) with #C8A96A (Gold) accents.
Use Playfair Display for headings and Poppins for body text.
Ensure the hero features a kinetic line-by-line masked text reveal using Framer Motion (use overflow-hidden wrappers on text lines).
Style the Google Map embed with a dark mode or grayscale CSS filter: `filter: grayscale(100%) invert(90%) hue-rotate(180deg)` to match the luxury aesthetic.
Do NOT use pure transparent backgrounds for the sticky navbar. Use `backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60`.
Do NOT use Vercel/Stripe 'card' styles. Use cardless rectangular or pill-shaped designs with generous padding.
Include `data-testid` on all interactive buttons, links, and forms.
Add a fixed WhatsApp floating icon at the bottom right corner with a gold background or gold border.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Avoid centered simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism.
Do not apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties.
Do not center-align the app container (`.App { text-align: center; }`).
Use 2-3x more spacing than usual (`py-24`, `gap-12`). Cramped designs look cheap.
Add hover states to ALL interactive elements. Use scale, border color transitions, and slight magnetic pulls.
Use the exact image URLs provided in the JSON payload to avoid placeholder slop.
